Legacy paint description:
A paint that protects your tank from three guns. Performs well against Firebird and somewhat protects against Freeze and Hammer. Only practical at close-range. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
